title: Not both

brief.story: A fault lamp on the club's 3D printer should stay on unless both safety checks pass: door shut (SA) and filament in (SB). Two transistors, Q1 and Q2, each switched by one input. The output's pull-up and LED are in. Q1 and Q2 aren't joined yet.
brief.goal: Join Q1 and Q2 so LED1 goes dark only when SA and SB are both on: a NAND gate.

hints: The output only goes low if current can get from it down to ground through Q1 and Q2: both switched on, one after the other. Series again.
Q1's emitter is in column 8, and Q2's collector in column 18. Join them with a wire.
A wire from a free hole in column 8 to one in column 18.

spec.label: LED1 = NOT (SA AND SB)
spec.explain: Two transistors in series pull the output down only when both are on.

debrief: Two transistors in series under a pull-up make NAND. It's the gate chips are made of: any logic at all, adders, memory, a whole CPU, can be built from NAND gates alone.
